en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central market square with several multi‑storey historic buildings. Dominating the right side is a large town hall with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and an ornate clock tower topped by a lantern. Smaller bourgeois houses line the left side of the square. A few people are walking across the open plaza. Red printed text at the top reads the place name and subject; the façade of the town hall bears the word "STADTHAUS".
